title: Personal Finance Overview
description: Financial command center with automatic MXN/USD conversion, clear interest tracking, and monthly cash-flow visibility.

query.rawSql: SELECT name FROM finance.accounts WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate) SELECT COALESCE(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END)), 0) AS value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account'

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END), 0) AS value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount > 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account'

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END), 0) AS value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account'

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate) SELECT COALESCE(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END)), 0) AS value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account' AND COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') = 'Sin categoría'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account'

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate) SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') <> 'Sin categoría' THEN ABS(CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END) ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(ABS(CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END)), 0), 1), 0) AS value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account'

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), base AS (SELECT t.txn_date, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END AS display_amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE $__timeFilter(t.txn_date) AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account') SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(txn_date, '1d'), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN display_amount > 0 THEN display_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "Income", COALESCE(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN display_amount < 0 THEN display_amount ELSE 0 END)), 0) AS "Outflow", COALESCE(SUM(display_amount), 0) AS "Net" FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), base AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', t.txn_date)::timestamp AS time, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END AS display_amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE $__timeFilter(t.txn_date) AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account'), daily AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(SUM(display_amount), 0) AS net FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) SELECT time, SUM(net) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Cumulative Net Flow" FROM daily ORDER BY time

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), base AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') AS category, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN t.amount WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN t.amount / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN t.amount * fx.rate ELSE t.amount END AS display_amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account'), cat AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS txns, ROUND(ABS(SUM(display_amount))::numeric, 2) AS total, ROUND(AVG(ABS(display_amount))::numeric, 2) AS avg_amount FROM base GROUP BY 1) SELECT category AS "Category", txns AS "Txns", total AS "Total", avg_amount AS "Avg Amount", ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(total) FROM cat), 0), 1) AS "Share %" FROM cat ORDER BY total DESC

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), tx AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.merchant, ''), regexp_replace(regexp_replace(t.description, '\s*;\s*TARJETA DIGITAL.*$', '', 'i'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS merchant, COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') AS category, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN ABS(t.amount) WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN ABS(t.amount) / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN ABS(t.amount) * fx.rate ELSE ABS(t.amount) END AS amount, t.txn_date FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account') SELECT merchant AS "Merchant", category AS "Category", COUNT(*) AS "Txns", ROUND(SUM(amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Total", ROUND(AVG(amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Amount", MAX(txn_date) AS "Last Date" FROM tx GROUP BY merchant, category ORDER BY "Total" DESC LIMIT 20

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), tx AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.merchant, ''), regexp_replace(regexp_replace(t.description, '\s*;\s*TARJETA DIGITAL.*$', '', 'i'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS merchant, COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') AS category, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN ABS(t.amount) WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN ABS(t.amount) / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN ABS(t.amount) * fx.rate ELSE ABS(t.amount) END AS amount, t.txn_date FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account') SELECT merchant AS "Merchant", category AS "Category", COUNT(*) AS "Txns", ROUND(SUM(amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Total", ROUND(AVG(amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Amount", MAX(txn_date) AS "Last Date" FROM tx GROUP BY merchant, category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY "Txns" DESC, "Total" DESC LIMIT 20

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), base AS (SELECT t.txn_date, a.name AS account, t.description, COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') AS category, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN ABS(t.amount) WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN ABS(t.amount) / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN ABS(t.amount) * fx.rate ELSE ABS(t.amount) END AS amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account') SELECT txn_date AS "Date", account AS "Account", description AS "Description", category AS "Category", amount AS "Amount" FROM base ORDER BY amount DESC, txn_date DESC LIMIT 20

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), tx AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.merchant, ''), regexp_replace(regexp_replace(t.description, '\s*;\s*TARJETA DIGITAL.*$', '', 'i'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS merchant, COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') AS category, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN ABS(t.amount) WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN ABS(t.amount) / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN ABS(t.amount) * fx.rate ELSE ABS(t.amount) END AS amount, t.txn_date FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account') SELECT merchant AS "Merchant", category AS "Category", ROUND(AVG(amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Amount", COUNT(*) AS "Txns", ROUND(SUM(amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Total", MAX(txn_date) AS "Last Date" FROM tx GROUP BY merchant, category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY "Txns" DESC, "Avg Amount" DESC LIMIT 20

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), tx AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.merchant, ''), regexp_replace(regexp_replace(t.description, '\s*;\s*TARJETA DIGITAL.*$', '', 'i'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS merchant, COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') AS category, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN ABS(t.amount) WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN ABS(t.amount) / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN ABS(t.amount) * fx.rate ELSE ABS(t.amount) END AS amount, t.txn_date FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount > 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account') SELECT merchant AS "Source", category AS "Category", COUNT(*) AS "Txns", ROUND(SUM(amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Total", ROUND(AVG(amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Amount", MAX(txn_date) AS "Last Date" FROM tx GROUP BY merchant, category ORDER BY "Total" DESC LIMIT 20

WITH fx AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT rate FROM finance.v_latest_fx_rates WHERE base_currency = 'USD' AND quote_currency = 'MXN' LIMIT 1), 18.5) AS rate), base AS (SELECT t.txn_date, a.name AS account, t.description, COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') AS category, CASE WHEN a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN ABS(t.amount) WHEN a.currency = 'MXN' AND '$display_currency' = 'USD' THEN ABS(t.amount) / fx.rate WHEN a.currency = 'USD' AND '$display_currency' = 'MXN' THEN ABS(t.amount) * fx.rate ELSE ABS(t.amount) END AS amount FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id CROSS JOIN fx WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.name ~ '$account' AND (t.description ILIKE '%INTEREST%' OR t.description ILIKE '%INTERÉS%' OR t.description ILIKE '%FINANCE CHARGE%' OR t.description ILIKE '%CARGO POR INTERESES%' OR t.description ILIKE '%COMMISSION%' OR t.description ILIKE '%FEE%') ) SELECT txn_date AS "Date", account AS "Account", description AS "Description", category AS "Category", amount AS "Amount" FROM base ORDER BY amount DESC, txn_date DESC LIMIT 50
